correctness.rationale: The channel consists of U_θ with probability q_t and spatially homogeneous global translations R,R^{-1} with p_t/2 each. Since R commutes with U_θ, every t-step Kraus word becomes a translation times U_θ^k; summing independent Bernoulli choice counts yields exactly X_t =d Q_{K_t}+S_{t−K_t}, K_t∼Bin(t,q_t). Independently built the full mixed-state channel on a 21-position periodic embedding with four steps, angle 0.7 and p=0.3; channel position probabilities match the explicit convolution to maximum error 5.55×10^−17. The coherent Konno limit for the fixed specified coin phase, binomial K_t concentration, classical CLT conditional on K_t, and |Q_k|≤k prove the q_t√t→0,→λ>0,→∞ regimes. Integrating the standard Konno density gives Var V=1−sinθ and κ4 V=−(1/2)(1−sinθ)^2(4−sinθ), strictly negative. This validates the limiting convolution and non-Gaussianity, not a local density limit or monitored first returns.
